Privacy Policy

When you request a quote, we receive the name, phone number and email you enter and the appointment type you choose. We keep them in HighLevel, the customer relationship system we use to manage inquiries, and use them to respond and discuss your project. If you call us, we use the information you provide the same way.

These pages are hosted through Netlify and ChatGPT Sites. Hosting providers may process technical information, such as IP addresses, browser details and request logs, to deliver and secure the pages. Our forms use Cloudflare Turnstile to confirm that a person, not an automated program, is sending them; Cloudflare receives browser and device information for that check. If you allow Targeting cookies in our cookie notice, we use the Meta Pixel (Meta Platforms) to measure our ads and to show our ads on Facebook and Instagram to people who visited these pages. It records pages viewed and that a quote or appointment request was sent, never the details you type into a form. For visitors in California, we turn on Meta's Limited Data Use setting, which restricts how Meta may use this data. If you decline or later turn Targeting off in the cookie settings, the Meta Pixel does not run. We do not use audience-tracking analytics. To protect our advertising from fraudulent clicks, our pages also use ClickCease, a click-fraud detection service from CHEQ. It receives technical information about each visit, such as IP address, browser and device details, to identify automated or invalid ad clicks. Because it is a security measure, it runs for every visitor. A cookie notice from CookieScript lets you review and change your cookie choices; it saves your choice in a cookie on your device.

For questions about information you provide, call John Crawford Company at (818) 884-5464. Read the full Privacy Policy.
